name: browlet-monorepo
description: Development workspace for Browlet, Stylelet, and Selectlet

scripts.lint: node --run typecheck && eslint src test scripts packages node-compat
scripts.test:selectlet:oracle: cross-env HARNESS_MODE=normal node scripts/with-node.mjs playwright test --project=selectlet
scripts.test:selectlet:oracle:fixme: cross-env HARNESS_MODE=fixme node scripts/with-node.mjs playwright test --project=selectlet
scripts.test:selectlet:browlet: cross-env HARNESS=browlet node scripts/with-node.mjs vitest run --project=browlet-host
scripts.test:stylelet:oracle: cross-env HARNESS_MODE=normal node scripts/with-node.mjs playwright test --project=stylelet
scripts.test:stylelet:oracle:fixme: cross-env HARNESS_MODE=fixme node scripts/with-node.mjs playwright test --project=stylelet
scripts.test:quick: node --run lint && node --run build && node --run test:unit && node --run test:node-compat && node --run test:artifact
scripts.test:all: node --run test:quick && node --run test:browlet:wpt && node --run test:selectlet:oracle && node --run test:stylelet:oracle
